content: SIDI iḥekkem, ejj tammurt ad tfarḥ, ad arecqent marra tegzirin.
Quwwaren as iseynuten d yijj n useynu ibbumbes, tasegda d řḥeqq aqa aten d dsas n řɛarc nnes.
Timessi teggur as zzat n wudem nnes, tqedd iɣrimen nnes i d as dd-ittennḍen.
Assamen nnes ssřaqqan ddunect, tammurt tẓarr i-tt, tenhezza.
Idurar fessyen am ccmeɛ zzat i wudem n SIDI, zzat i wudem n Sidi n marra tammurt.
Ijenwan ttbarrḥen tasegda nnes, marra řegnus ttwařan aɛuǧi nnes.
Ejj ad seḍḥan marra inni ɛebbden i řexyařat ineqcen n ukeccuḍ, marra inni ittcennɛen di l’aṣnam. Bendqem zzates, kenniw, marra irebbiten!
Ṣihyun isřa, ifarḥ, yessis n Yahuda arecqent, zi ssibbet n řeḥkamat nnec, a SIDI.
Maɣar Cek, a SIDI, d Amɛuǧi x marra tammurt, Cek d wenni yuɛřan qaɛ x marra irebbiten.
Kenniw i ittexsen SIDI, carhem řɣar. Netta iḥeṭṭa x řeɛmur n imtiqqan nnes, Netta ittfekka i-ten zeg ufus n iɛeffanen.
Tafawt tᵉttwazarɛ i umsegged, řefraḥet i yinni ɣar iǧa uř iseggmen.
Kenniw imseggaden, farḥem zi SIDI, qadam xmi tᵉttidarem taqeddast nnes.
